about: IM-2 photo-import corpus (AI Road to 10, Sprint 2). Binaries live OUTSIDE the repo under IMPORT_CORPUS_DIR (default C:/Users/isaia/import-corpus); this file holds what each item is, where it came from, its sha256, and the ANSWER KEY written by looking at it. Graded by scripts/evals/suites/import-corpus.mjs.
keyFormat: "<name> | <rx>" per main-work row, in card order. rx: "5x5" sets x reps · "4x8-12" a rep range · "3x30s" / "1x15min" a clock · "5x30yd" a distance (sets graded, distance not representable) · "6/6/4/4" a per-set ladder (F = to failure) · "?" anything (e.g. "2x?" = 2 sets, reps unstated) · optional " @70%" or " @65,75,80%" percentages. A leading "? " marks a row that may or may not be imported (an ambiguous warm-up line). Warm-up and cool-down rows are not keyed.
